summary: Iteration 138: verified (1) registration auto-login (backend + UI), (2) session persistence after reload, (3) SiteMenu no longer crashes on the Lab tab (TOOL_CATS ReferenceError fixed) and shows the 4 functional groups, (4) admin login regression. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed. Frontend: all 4 flows passed, no page errors.

minor.issue: Rate limit 5/hour per IP is shared across all preview traffic; repeated automated registration tests get 429. Not a product bug, but test runs must clear the `rate_limits` doc _id 'register:<ip>' first (script /app/backend/tests/_clear_ratelimit.py).

issues: Tool search matches only the label in the CURRENT UI language (searching 'forno' with EN UI returns 'No results.'). Consider matching all 4 translations.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/register: verify_enabled is a hardcoded local flag; the whole verification branch (_send_verification, needs_verification) is now dead code. Consider driving it from an env var so it can be re-enabled without code change.
SiteMenu.jsx tool search: use all language variants of the label in the norm() filter.
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway users qa_<epoch>@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (registration tests). Not deleted (no delete-user endpoint).
test_credentials: admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! (works). New registrations: qa_<epoch>@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register auto-login confirmed: POST /api/auth/register returns {user, session_token} (no needs_verification); /auth/me and /community/posts work with that Bearer token. UI: header login-btn -> auth-tab-register -> auth-name/email/password/confirm -> auth-submit; auth screen closes and login-btn disappears; nav-tab-community shows data-testid=community with no community-auth-gate; survives reload. SiteMenu: site-menu-open in header, groups site-menu-kind-genera/gestione/registri/info all render, 46 site-menu-tool-* rows, clicking site-menu-tool-generatore opens the tool. site-menu-admin shown for admin. Note: registration is rate-limited 5/h per IP — run /app/backend/tests/_clear_ratelimit.py before register tests. The 401s in console (/auth/me, /combos/sync, /favorites/sync, /notifications) occur only in the pre-login guest state and are expected.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — both reported fixes verified working. Only observation: register rate limiting (429) can mask register test failures; clear rate_limits before testing.
